summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares the Bria-IMT regimen plus the checkpoint inhibitor retifanlimab with physician's choice chemotherapy in advanced metastatic breast cancer. Bria-IMT includes a single intravenous dose of cyclophosphamide 2 to 3 days before four intradermal inoculations of the experimental SV-BR-1-GM product, with interferon at each site, and retifanlimab is given by infusion; cycle length and total number of cycles are not stated. The main outcome measured is overall survival.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara el régimen Bria-IMT más el inhibidor de punto de control retifanlimab con quimioterapia elegida por el médico en cáncer de mama metastásico avanzado. Bria-IMT incluye una dosis intravenosa única de ciclofosfamida 2 a 3 días antes de cuatro inoculaciones intradérmicas del producto experimental SV-BR-1-GM, con interferón en cada sitio, y retifanlimab se administra por infusión; la duración del ciclo y el número total de ciclos no se indican. El resultado principal que se mide es la supervivencia global.
who_for: Adult, at least 18 years old, who signed informed consent.
Breast cancer that is unresectable locally recurrent or metastatic, after failing prior therapy.
Prior treatment requirements depend on HER2, hormone receptor, triple negative, BRCA or HER2-low status.
Brain metastases allowed if clinically stable, without steroids for at least 2 weeks.
Expected survival of at least 4 months and ECOG performance status 0, 1 or 2.
not_for: Chemotherapy, immunotherapy or major surgery within 21 days before the first dose.
Radiotherapy within 14 days before the first dose.
Unresolved toxicity from prior therapy, or grade 3 or higher toxicity from prior checkpoint inhibitor.
Known hypersensitivity to study therapies, beef, or components of SV-BR-1-GM.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past year, or pregnancy or nursing.
